Claim: PM loop round 10 · 2026-10-18T22:09Z · as filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (p1, `area:studio`; ruling A item 3 on #24324, 6250704607). The draft save records `draftChanges`, per-key provenance under the writer's contract in `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.draftChanges`'s describe, and the strict draft read serves it. First the save request declares its authoring surface, so a Studio save, an in-process copilot save and any other caller are told apart.
Session: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs as its own cloud session, named in the dispatch comment)
Account: `os-project-manager` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24395-draft-changes-writer`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24395`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#1` (seat post #6367)
File surface:
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`:
  - the draft save (`saveMetaItem` with `mode: 'draft'`) reads the surface input and hands it to the write;
  - the strict draft read (`getMetaItem` with `state: 'draft'` from a stored row) serves `draftChanges`. It is absent on the active read, the cached branch and `?preview=draft`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`:
  - `put` with `state: 'draft'`, inside `resolveWriteHead`'s transaction, compares the new body with the body it replaces: the draft row, else the active row, else nothing (`[]`). It keeps one entry per path, replacing every entry at or under a changed path;
  - `promoteDraft` and the draft discard leave no entry behind;
  - a `migrate-stored` rewrite records no path.
- The entries' home on the draft row. If it is a new `sys_metadata` column (`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts`), the dev measures it on each driver's schema sync. ⛔ Never inside the stored body.
- Cross-domain exception, declared to `domain:spec` on #6017 (and the filer, #18549) before the queue: `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`.
  - The surface input on `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema`.
  - The closed set `copilot | studio | api` moves into one exported schema that `draftChanges.by` uses too. An absent input stamps `api`.
- Cross-lane, declared to `domain:cli` (#6024, #22648) before the queue: the input's spelling on the two HTTP save doors, `packages/rest/src/meta-save-request.ts` (the REST write doors read through it) and the dispatcher's save in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`.
  - Both refuse `copilot`, which only an in-process tool may state.
  - The draft read needs no transport change on either door (review 6253694122 ③ 4).
- Pins beside each: each `by` value; the replace-at-or-under rule; the first-save baseline; every absence case; the HTTP doors' refusal of `copilot`; publish and discard leave nothing. One changeset per package touched, `.changeset/24395-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not objectui's reader (objectstack-ai/objectui#12725 item 3), not cloud's `stageDraft` / `applyDraft`, no new error code beyond the refusal's existing family.
- If no acceptable way exists for Studio's saves to declare `studio`, stop and report. Narrowing the published set is BREAKING and is filed as its own card, never slipped in.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (measured on a booted server: draft saves through the REST door, the dispatcher and the in-process call, then the strict draft read on both HTTP doors, and each absence case, before and after), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: yes (widening) (the save request gains an input and the closed set gains an exported name; owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, on the published-schema face, before the queue)
Responsibility: `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.draftChanges` is published with no writer, so Studio cannot mark a key the copilot drafted | the spec key landed (#24298, `584b4225e1`) with the writer's contract in its describe, and the draft save already reads the row it replaces inside one transaction | every Studio author reviewing a copilot draft before publish (ruling A item 3 on #24324; objectui#12725 item 3)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists and the `pm:dispatched` claims were read at this claim.
- PR #24401 (#24360, this seat) touches `protocol.ts`: three copy sentences in lock refusals, disjoint from the draft save and read. It lands first; this card's dev merges `main` before the PR opens.
- PR #24398 (#24338, `domain:spec`) touches `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` and `object-schema-fls-references.ts`. This card names neither.
- No open PR touches `protocol.zod.ts`, `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `sys-metadata.object.ts`, `meta-save-request.ts` or `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`.
- #23561 (`domain:spec`, `pm:dispatched`) holds `protocol.ts`'s `duplicatePackage` region, which this card does not meet; whichever lands second merges `main`.
